title: Kitchen and Garden
author: Ansel Reyes
blurb: Silas Eastwick, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
